focus.title: What I do

items.title: Leadership and teams.
items.text: I build and grow engineering teams: hiring, onboarding, mentoring and objective-based reviews, with autonomy and a healthy engineering culture.

items.title: Software delivery and quality.
items.text: Agile practices (Scrum, XP, Kanban), quality standards, automated code review, CI/CD and metrics to deliver more value with fewer incidents.

items.title: AI applied to development.

items.title: Business and delivery.
items.text: Ownership of financial results, project portfolio, pre-sales and relationships with clients and leadership.

ai.title: Applied AI
ai.intro: Generative AI is changing how we build software. I have brought it into real teams, and I study it and use it in depth.

items.title: Adoption in development teams (VASS).
items.text: Together with other leaders, I drove the adoption of generative AI across the area's development teams, with an AI-assisted workflow and harness on live projects. Small features and fixes that could take around two days were delivered autonomously in less time and against more objective quality criteria: roughly 30% more delivered value (my own estimate).

items.title: Master's in AI Engineering (LIDR, 2026).
items.text: LLM applications, RAG and CAG, agents and agentic systems, and AI evaluation.

items.title: tick-tack-done.
items.text: My personal project: a task and productivity app with an MCP server, so AI agents can work with it. I build it with AI agents and a GitHub backlog workflow.

about.title: About me
items: I started out as a web developer and, over the years, learned that good projects come from good teams. I have moved from designing and building software to growing and leading development teams, without losing my curiosity about how things work and how to make them better. I like staying close to technology, connecting what the business needs with what we can realistically build, and creating environments where people have autonomy, grow and build good software.
Today I am especially interested in how AI is changing the way we build software, learn and work. I am looking for a new role where I can keep combining engineering and leadership.
I am a father of twins. You will find me in the mountains, on a rugby pitch or travelling.
